programs.description: Subramanyam and his family attempt to avert several problems that come their way when they move into a new house in a locality filled with bizarre individuals.
Greedy for power under the influence of a wicked politician, a village sarpanch murders his brother and separates his family.
The host, Jay Raval, engages in an insightful conversation with eminent Gujarati folk singer, Divya Chaudhary, who shares her musical journey.
The host engages in a conversation with Gujarati folk legend Atul Purohit, reflecting on his artistic journey and the cultural roots of his music.
